audit.whatIsWrong: Volibear's kit is mapped to the wrong slots throughout the content layer. The text calls his stun 'his E' (it is Thundering Smash, Q) and says 'his R shields him on cast' (the shield is Sky Splitter, E; Stormbringer grants bonus Health, not a shield). It also says his W bite slows — Frenzied Maul does not slow.
audit.why: Riot text — Q Thundering Smash: 'gains speed towards enemies, Stunning and damaging the first one he Attacks' (12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, auto reset). E Sky Splitter: 'dealing damage and Slowing enemies while granting Volibear a Shield if he's inside the blast radius' (flat 16s). R Stormbringer: 'leaps to a target location, Slowing and damaging enemies beneath him while gaining bonus Health. Enemy towers near his landing location become temporarily disabled.' W Frenzied Maul: on-hit, second cast on the same target heals — no slow.
audit.corrected: Stun is Thundering Smash (Q), 10s at max rank. Shield is Sky Splitter (E), flat 16s. Stormbringer is a leap with bonus health, a slow, and a tower disable. The slow comes from Sky Splitter, not the bite.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart said Skill at level 1 and Skill at 2+ items, and Volibear at levels 3 and 4-5 — the exact inverse of the packet chart and of the whys sitting beside it.
audit.why: Level 1-2 is Volibear's (Frenzied Maul sustain, ramping passive, no Irelia stun yet). Level 3 and 4-5 are genuinely skill: Flawless Duet versus Thundering Smash, whoever lands CC first. From 6 onward and at 2+ items he out-brawls her. Win rate 45.28% over 689 games confirms Volibear-favoured overall.
audit.corrected: Volibear, Volibear, Skill, Skill, Volibear, Volibear, Volibear — matched pairs in both layers, ratings adjusted.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike attributed the shield to Stormbringer, so the player is told to fear the wrong ability at the wrong time.
audit.why: Sky Splitter's shield is available from level 3 on a flat 16s cooldown, long before 6; Stormbringer's threat is the leap, the bonus health, and the tower disable that enables the dive.
audit.corrected: Spike text rewritten to separate the two.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was mentioned only in the item list, never tied to the ability that makes it necessary.
audit.why: Frenzied Maul's repeat cast on a marked target heals him on a 5s cooldown, which is what wins him every extended trade.
audit.corrected: The 'Extend into his W heal' don't now names Frenzied Maul and Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are a knife-edge: your Ionian Fervor stacking and reset chain come fully online, but so does his E stun, and if he catches your Bladesurge dash with it he locks you out of your whole reset chain. Trade ONLY when his E is down — bait it, W-channel his empowered auto, then E-Q in and out before his W heal recovers. At 6 the lane tilts back to him: his R shields him on cast and empowers his all-in, and you simply cannot burst through that shield while his W heals faster than your on-hit and armor shred can chunk him. Respect the dive — Voli pairs the R shield with raw tankiness to brawl through your burst.

notes: Largest defect in this slice: the whole Volibear content layer had his stun on E and his shield on R. Stun is Thundering Smash (Q), shield is Sky Splitter (E), R is a leap with bonus health and a tower disable. Frenzied Maul was also credited with a slow it does not have. packet.defects also flags 'Relentless Storm' — real name is The Relentless Storm; corrected in spikes[0]. Difficulty relabelled from EVEN to HARD to match a 45.28% win rate and a chart Volibear owns in five of seven rows.
